nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be {full-path-stem}_{entity}, every directory segment kept, so semantic-subagent IDs match the AST extractor's ID scheme exactly; using just the filename or only the immediate parent directory creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes when merged with AST output.

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: INFERRED edges must pick one of five fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) rather than a free continuous 0-1 range, because models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges - production data showed a bimodal collapse (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) when a continuous range was allowed, so the range guidance was being ignored in favor of a binary default.
